One account for delivery, COD, invoices, and seller payouts.

NovaX is not only a courier portal. It is the operating account for a seller's daily orders, delivery charges, cash collection, payable balance, disputes, and invoices.

Cash on DeliveryBook COD orders, collect cash through riders, and release seller payable only after delivery proof and cash collection.
Business SuiteClient dashboard, bulk booking, sub accounts, invoices, payment history, reports, and live support data in one place.
Fast Settlement PathBuild toward premium T+1 payouts after scan health, rider cash, and invoice accuracy stay clean.
Track OrderConsignees can check order status directly with NovaX tracking instead of waiting for WhatsApp replies.
Launch network

Five city lanes built for speed, proof, and COD discipline.

Each lane has pickup controls, warehouse scans, transit aging, destination receiving, rider proof, returns, and cash accountability.

KarachiSeller pickups, origin sorting, branch cash controls.
LahoreHigh-volume delivery, refusal review, redelivery flows.
IslamabadDestination scans, clean receiving, settlement-ready proof.
RawalpindiRider proof, return validation, consignee communication.
FaisalabadOverland growth lane for heavier seller shipments.
How NovaX works

From order booking to seller payment without blind spots.

01Seller books one order or uploads bulk orders.
02Rider pickup is scanned before parcel enters branch custody.
03Warehouse scan and sack manifest prevent parcel leakage.
04Destination branch receives, ages, and assigns delivery.
05Rider delivery proof unlocks COD collection.
06Invoice and payout appear in seller account.
Financing path

Start with courier truth. Grow into wallets, payment links, and working capital.

NovaX can become fintech only after the courier ledger is clean: delivered parcels, rider cash, branch deposits, invoices, and seller balances must match.

Shopify Link Integration

No NovaX Shopify app, no OAuth, no Partner app Client ID. Generate a client's link, they add one webhook in their own Shopify Admin, and orders import automatically once a real signed order arrives.

No app required

Send this URL to the client, or have them generate their own from their Store Integrations tab. They add it as a webhook in Shopify Admin → Settings → Notifications → Webhooks (Event: Order creation, Format: JSON), then paste the "Signing secret" Shopify shows them back into NovaX.

Shopify Integration Health

Real backend status per client -- never shows "Live" until a real signed webhook order has actually been received.
